pass_mark: Fixed on 2026-10-09 before any held-back number was read (protocol SHA-256 68b833108c589ce7a6e063ec84b21483fa50c7cffa145108e69ed0de816c92db). Root-mean-square error over the samples of the four held-back cultures: dry biomass to 170 h at most 2.15 g/L; glucose 0.85 g/L; galacturonate 2.74 g/L; mucic acid 4.51 g/L; carbon dioxide made 0.00265 mol; oxygen taken up 0.0153 mol. Each line is one and a half times the root-mean-square difference between the two repeats of a fitted condition, so it is set by the measurement and not by the model. The solver passes only if all six are met. The forecast, written beforehand, was that it would miss the carbon dioxide line by a factor of three to five and miss the glucose line. Scored beside it on the same points: the mean of the two fitted cultures at the same yeast extract (feed glucose makes no difference), the mean of all eight fitted cultures, the starting value held, and the same equations with constants not taken from this data. A line that one of the first two also meets, or on which the solver is not closer than both, is not evidence for the model.
